title: Severe RAG Hallucination Spike Following Knowledge Base Update
context: A customer support enterprise RAG pipeline deployed with a vector database (Pinecone/Qdrant) starts returning incorrect policy answers after ingesting 5,000 new unstructured PDF policy documents.
dilemma: How do you systematically diagnose whether the hallucination is caused by chunking strategy, vector embedding distance metrics, top-k retrieval noise, or LLM system prompt weakness?

key_competencies: RAG Triad Evaluation (Context Relevance, Groundedness, Answer Relevance)
must_include: Evaluating RAG Triad with TruLens or Ragas
common_pitfalls: Assuming vector database is broken without automated eval pipeline

star_model_answer.situation: A production enterprise RAG system experienced a 22% spike in hallucinated customer support answers after a document refresh.
star_model_answer.task: Diagnose root cause and restore RAG precision to >95%.
star_model_answer.action: I deployed an automated Ragas evaluation pipeline to measure Groundedness and Context Relevance separately. The data showed low Context Relevance due to naive 1000-token fixed chunking splitting tables. I refactored to semantic markdown chunking, introduced a hybrid BM25 + Vector retrieval with a Cross-Encoder re-ranker, and added strict groundedness system prompts.
star_model_answer.result: Groundedness accuracy reached 97.4%, latency remained under 600ms, and customer support escalation tickets fell by 40%.

title: Latency vs Accuracy Bottleneck in High-Throughput Real-Time Call Summarization
context: A call center application processes 50,000 call transcripts per hour. Using GPT-4o API costs $40,000/month and introduces a 3.5-second latency per call. The business demands cost reduction by 80% and sub-1-second latency.
dilemma: How do you design a fine-tuning or distillation strategy using open-source models (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B / Mistral) with QLoRA and vLLM inference backend to meet performance targets?

star_model_answer.situation: High API cost ($40k/mo) and latency (3.5s) on GPT-4o threatened call center AI product viability.
star_model_answer.task: Deliver sub-1s latency and 80%+ cost savings while maintaining summarization quality.
star_model_answer.action: I curated 5,000 high-quality GPT-4o call summaries as a distillation dataset. I fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA on 2x A10G GPUs, quantized the model to INT4 using AWQ, and deployed it on vLLM with PagedAttention.
star_model_answer.result: Latency dropped to 420ms (88% reduction), API costs plummeted by 84%, and blind human evaluations showed zero statistically significant drop in summary quality.
